basis: StressWeb (arxiv 2604.16385) axes x intensity + clean reference; WebArena too-clean-environment flaw (arxiv 2407.01502)
determinism: no Math.random; attempt-counter fault schedule; input-event-anchored mutations (setTimeout 0), not timer races
heldout_note: cells derive only from the v1-style clean template; the held-out mock site is never read (locked by test)

clean.design_intent: clean reference (StressWeb): fallback selectors hit directly, 0 repairs expected

perception-light.design_intent: fallback selectors miss; semantic attributes intact -> repair recovers
perception-light.recoverable_in_principle: yes — aria-label/placeholder/text still identify both targets

perception-medium.design_intent: drift + deception; repair must pick the real control over the decoy
perception-medium.recoverable_in_principle: yes — decoy is heuristically excludable, semantics intact

perturbations: real search field has NO search semantics (generic placeholder)
visible 'Promo code' bait field placed before the form
hidden ghost input with the search aria-label
perception-heavy.design_intent: a text/a11y-only matcher ties the bait field with the real one and fills the wrong field -> empty query -> honest fail
perception-heavy.recoverable_in_principle: yes — form proximity or visual grounding disambiguates

action-light.design_intent: thin a11y signal but still enumerable -> repair recovers

perturbations: stale snapshot: first input event rebuilds the form nodes (new ids sb1/btn1, observed data-aid handles die, value preserved)
action-medium.design_intent: the DOM the agent observed no longer exists at click time -> re-observe + repair recovers
action-medium.recoverable_in_principle: yes — a fresh observation sees the rebuilt nodes

perturbations: a11y-tree omission: submit is a bare <span onclick> with no role — it never appears in the observer's candidate enumeration
action-heavy.design_intent: the submit control is invisible to an a11y-tree-only agent -> repair cannot find it -> honest fail
action-heavy.recoverable_in_principle: yes — Enter in the single-input form implicit-submits

perturbations: results render 250ms late (simulated XHR delay, inside the agent's 400ms settle window)
execution-light.design_intent: benign latency; success expected with 0 repairs

perturbations: mid-task element removal: after the query is typed, #search-btn is replaced by #resubmit (different id)
execution-medium.design_intent: the planned click target vanished mid-task -> repair finds the replacement = measurable mid-task recovery

perturbations: deterministic 500: first submit renders 'Server error (500)' and no results; retries would succeed (attempt counter, no randomness)
execution-heavy.design_intent: selector recovery succeeds but the first submit 500s; Script Mode has no retry loop -> honest fail (checkpoint pass, success fail)
